_meta.what: Directed lead-lag predictability on daily changes: R2 increment from adding five lags of the leading series to five own-lags, permutation p-values (time-shifted null, 300 draws). Predictability in this sense is an association across time, never causality, and none of this is a forecast or investment advice.
